coverage_notes: Seven source-mapped cases have original Flash captures; each reached its intended source target and produced 602 fighter/helper state rows.
All seven captured cases match current GameWorld fighter states, comparable helper fields, and available root-position observations exactly.

The seventh fixture invokes summon twice on one helper instance: source helper_spawn occurs at fight ticks 15 and 145; action=1 survives natural hide at tick 100 and remains through second activation at tick 146.
The catalog does not cover every reachable action, cancellation boundary, visual timeline, or audio event; captured cases are not whole-character completion.
